name: 87 - API - Manage Communication Channel Adapters - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT $1::TEXT action,$2::TEXT clinic_name,NULLIF($3::TEXT,'') channel,
         NULLIF($4::TEXT,'') adapter_name,NULLIF($5::TEXT,'') adapter_url,
         NULLIF($6::TEXT,'') credential_reference,$7::BOOLEAN enabled,
         $8::INTEGER timeout_seconds,$9::JSONB metadata
),
c AS (
  SELECT clinics.id clinic_id,r.*
  FROM clinics,r WHERE clinics.name=r.clinic_name AND clinics.is_active=TRUE LIMIT 1
),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO communication_channel_adapters(
    clinic_id,channel,adapter_name,adapter_url,credential_reference,
    enabled,request_timeout_seconds,metadata,updated_at
  )
  SELECT c.clinic_id,c.channel,c.adapter_name,c.adapter_url,c.credential_reference,
         c.enabled,c.timeout_seconds,c.metadata,NOW()
  FROM c WHERE c.action='upsert'
  ON CONFLICT(clinic_id,channel) DO UPDATE SET
    adapter_name=EXCLUDED.adapter_name,
    adapter_url=EXCLUDED.adapter_url,
    credential_reference=EXCLUDED.credential_reference,
    enabled=EXCLUDED.enabled,
    request_timeout_seconds=EXCLUDED.request_timeout_seconds,
    metadata=communication_channel_adapters.metadata||EXCLUDED.metadata,
    updated_at=NOW()
  RETURNING *
),
status_changed AS (
  UPDATE communication_channel_adapters a
  SET enabled=(c.action='enable'),updated_at=NOW()
  FROM c
  WHERE c.action IN ('enable','disable')
    AND a.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
    AND a.channel=c.channel
  RETURNING a.*
),
listed AS (
  SELECT a.id,a.channel,a.adapter_name,a.adapter_url,a.credential_reference,
         a.enabled,a.request_timeout_seconds,a.metadata,a.created_at,a.updated_at
  FROM communication_channel_adapters a JOIN c ON c.clinic_id=a.clinic_id
  WHERE c.action='list'
  ORDER BY a.channel
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c) THEN FALSE
       WHEN r.action='upsert' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upserted) THEN FALSE
       WHEN r.action IN ('enable','disable') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM status_changed) THEN FALSE
       ELSE TRUE END success,
  CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c) THEN 'clinic_not_found'
       WHEN r.action='upsert' THEN 'channel_adapter_upserted'
       WHEN r.action='enable' THEN 'channel_adapter_enabled'
       WHEN r.action='disable' THEN 'channel_adapter_disabled'
       ELSE 'channel_adapters_listed' END result,
  COALESCE((SELECT id FROM upserted),(SELECT id FROM status_changed)) adapter_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(listed)) FROM listed),'[]'::JSONB) adapters
FROM r;

parameters.content:
## تنظیم Adapter کانال

اقدام‌ها: upsert, enable, disable, list

Adapter URL باید یک سرویس داخلی یا واسط Provider باشد.

Secret واقعی در دیتابیس قرار نده؛ فقط credential_reference ثبت می‌شود.
